python3 -c "
import pandas as pd
from openpyxl import load_workbook

df = pd.read_excel('budget.xlsx', sheet_name='Budget', header=None)
exp = df.iloc[10:22].copy()
exp.columns = ['category','item','amount']
exp = exp.dropna(subset=['amount'])
exp['amount'] = pd.to_numeric(exp['amount'], errors='coerce')
print('Per-category totals:')
print(exp.groupby('category')['amount'].sum().to_string())
print('Grand total expenses:', exp['amount'].sum())

wb = load_workbook('budget.xlsx', data_only=False)
ws = wb['Budget']
print('Total Expenses cell (C23):', repr(ws['C23'].value))
"
